resolvedQuestions.text: Which configuration surface (file, environment variable, or both) minimizes operator friction while staying auditable?
How does a discovered local endpoint auto-construct the provider record used by the plugin and the wrapper, including LM Studio and Ollama OpenAI-compatible cases?
What judge default permits local accepts without weakening the reject-only safety contract for hosted projection?
How do local-only privacy defaults keep local-classified content on the local endpoint and never cascade to hosted services without explicit consent?
How do the plugin and wrapper automatically pick up the configured provider, reconciled with the default-off enablement gate?

keyFindings.label: Public config API exports only isProjectionEnabled; no provider discovery exists
Enablement-on is still a no-op: plugin empty candidateProviderIds and wrapper never calls runWrapperProjection
Simplest auditable surface is extending enablement.local.json; env stays on/off overlay
LM Studio OpenAI-compatible local must use createLlamaCppModelRecord; GENERIC_HOSTED is hosted-only
Operator file needs only kind+model; presets fill credential none:local, no-fallback, protocol
Reuse createRejectOnlyMeaningJudge with judgeMode required; no new judge
Plugin judgeMode disabled is not why good rewrites fail; empty candidateProviderIds is
Loader emits local-offline policy, egressConsent false, fallback none; hosted cannot cascade
Wrapper bin must call shared loader then runWrapperProjection; today it passthroughs
Loader must supply shipped copy-editing systemInstruction; plugin PROMPT is empty
Ranked first choice: extend enablement.local.json with localProvider; shared loader; judgeMode required; local-only policy
